node.title: L1 FPC5: large-source full-petal payment
node.statement: Aggregate every first-owned FPC5 contributor on the remaining large source scales after the exact proved prefilter (PF6). Every survivor has a proved affine anchor chart and joint owner; owner cancellation reduces co-deficiency c to a primitive touched-petal determinant AV-CU=Lambda K with deg K at most c. The conclusion is one disjoint polynomial/profile allocation across the surviving source layouts, touched-petal sets, determinant tails, and exact owners.
